arStrings.szText: The Kurast Undercity is now unlocked. Beware:{c_red}Andariel{/c} has taken hold in it. Find and utilize {c_highlight}Andariel's Tributes{/c} when starting a run to increase your chances of encountering her. {c_highlight}Return her Corrupted Essences to Hadriel{/c} to unlock Divine Gifts.
